faqs.question: What is FundedNext?
faqs.answer: FundedNext is a proprietary trading firm founded in March 2022 and headquartered in Ajman, United Arab Emirates. It offers 1-Step, 2-Step, Stellar Lite and Instant Funding evaluation models on CFD accounts from $6,000 to $200,000, plus a separate futures division, and has paid out more than $300M to over 95,000 traders as of 2026.

seo.title: What is FundedNext? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundedNext is a UAE-based prop firm founded in 2022. Learn how its Stellar, Evaluation and Instant Funding models work.

faqs.question: What is the FundedNext profit split?
faqs.answer: The default reward share is 80% for the trader and 20% for FundedNext. Paying for the 90% or 95% split add-on at checkout raises your share immediately, while reaching FundedNext Pro status (4 qualifying reward cycles with at least 4% growth each, over 2+ months) permanently lifts CFD accounts to a 90% split. Futures Rapid and Legacy accounts pay a full 100% split with no upgrade needed.

seo.title: FundedNext Profit Split: 80% to 95% | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundedNext starts at 80%, with paid add-ons to 90–95% for CFDs and a full 100% split on futures accounts.

faqs.question: How often can I request a payout from FundedNext?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on the account model: Stellar 1-Step and Instant accounts unlock a first reward after 5 trading days, while Stellar 2-Step and Evaluation accounts wait 14–21 calendar days for the first cycle. Later cycles run weekly or bi-weekly depending on the plan. FundedNext commits to processing every approved payout within 24 hours, and pays a $1,000 compensation bonus if it misses that window.

seo.title: FundedNext Payout Cycle and 24-Hour Guarantee | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundedNext pays weekly or bi-weekly depending on plan, with a 24-hour processing guarantee or a $1,000 penalty payout.

faqs.question: What withdrawal methods and fees does FundedNext charge?
faqs.answer: FundedNext supports bank wire, cryptocurrency (USDT), Skrill and card payouts, all starting from a $250 minimum. A processing fee of up to 3.5% is deducted from every withdrawal regardless of method; crypto withdrawals may also incur separate network/gas fees. There is no fee to request a payout beyond this processing charge.

seo.title: FundedNext Withdrawal Methods and Fees | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: FundedNext charges up to a 3.5% processing fee on bank, card, Skrill and crypto payouts starting at a $250 minimum.

faqs.question: How does the FundedNext Pro scaling plan work?
faqs.answer: After receiving 4 Performance Rewards with at least 4% account growth in each qualifying cycle, and staying active for a minimum of 2 months, your account is automatically scaled up 25% and your reward share rises to 90%. Each further qualifying cycle adds another 25%, up to a $4,000,000 ceiling. Cycles under 4% growth simply don't count toward the total rather than resetting your progress.
